name: Hintersteiner See
kurzbeschreibung: Hintersteiner See at 882 m in the Naturschutzgebiet Wilder Kaiser: crystal-clear spring water of drinking quality, lido, and 5 km circular trail.
preis: Rundweg kostenlos; Strandbad Erwachsene ca. 6,00 €, Kinder 4,50 €
oeffnungszeiten: Rundweg 24/7 frei zugänglich; Strandbad Ende Mai–Sep täglich ca. 08:30–19:00 Uhr
beschreibung:
Overview

The Hintersteiner See is a crystal-clear mountain lake situated at an altitude of 882 meters in the municipality of Scheffau am Wilden Kaiser in the Tyrolean Unterland. Embedded in the strictly protected Naturschutzgebiet Wilder Kaiser, the lake spans an area of approximately 0.56 square kilometers and measures 36 meters at its deepest point. Fed by underground karst springs from the mighty massif of the Wilder Kaiser, the water boasts pristine drinking quality. Thanks to its turquoise-blue hue and unspoiled natural scenery, Hintersteiner See is regarded as one of the finest natural jewels in the entire Alpine region.

Natural Phenomenon & Circular Trail

The lake was formed during the last Ice Age around 15,000 years ago, when the moraine wall of a retreating glacier dammed the basin. The water is exceptionally pure and refreshingly cool: even in midsummer, temperatures rarely exceed 20 to 22 °C. On the eastern shore lies the official Strandbad Scheffau am Hintersteiner See: an idyllic sunbathing lawn with sun terrace, changing cubicles, and bathing jetties. Because the rest of the shoreline is strictly protected, swimming is permitted exclusively within the lido area. Among the region's most popular hikes is the 5.2-kilometer Hintersteiner See-Rundweg: the leisurely hike takes around 1.5 to 2 hours and circles the entire body of water. The sunny northern shore follows a quiet asphalted road, while the shaded southern shore enchants as a natural forest trail with gentle climbs, root-strewn paths, and spectacular views looking down upon the turquoise waters.

Visit & Getting There

The circular trail and lake shorelines are freely accessible throughout the year. The Strandbad Hintersteiner See is open in fine bathing weather from late May to September daily from approx. 08:00/09:00 to 19:00. Lido admission prices (2025/2026 season): adult day ticket approx. €6.00 (with regional Wilder Kaiser GästeCard €5.50), children approx. €4.50; afternoon tickets from 13:00 from €5.00. Arrival by car: from Scheffau take the narrow Hintersteiner-See-Straße up to the paid parking lot on the eastern shore (Hinterstein 52/57). As parking fills up quickly on hot summer days and wild camping is strictly prohibited, the eco-friendly KaiserJet-Wanderbus (Hintersteiner See line) is recommended, running hourly in summer from Scheffau Dorf and the cable car station directly to the lakeshore (free with guest card).

Tips

The northern shore of the circular trail is paved, flat, and fully accessible for strollers and wheelchairs; the wooded southern shore requires sturdy footwear and surefootedness. After your walk, the Seestüberl on the eastern shore or the alpine inn Goingstätt on the western shore welcome you for Tyrolean alpine delicacies accompanied by lake views.
